title: Nha Trang islands in a day
summary: Hon Mun is a boat day. Hon Tre is a day on the island. Take one. Fees are Check on arrival.

stops.name: Hon Mun

seoTitle: Nha Trang islands in a day
seoDescription: One day on the water at Nha Trang: Hon Mun or Hon Tre. Each is a day. Fees are Check on arrival.
